note: Human-control sources (plan.md section 5). human.py refuses to ingest a source until license_status is "confirmed", which is set by a person after reading the source's actual terms; record what was read and when in license_checked.

persuade.name: PERSUADE 2.0 corpus
persuade.collected: before November 2022: the corpus was the basis of Kaggle's Feedback Prize (2021-2022) per the PERSUADE 1.0 README; collection years and writing conditions are not stated in the README or the 1.0 paper
persuade.writers: US students, grades 6-12; providers in the data: Indiana, Virginia, Florida, NCES, Georgia Virtual (online school; 701 essays, one prompt, no grade recorded)
persuade.provenance_method: assembled by researchers from a ~500,000-essay collection of student writing and publicly released before generative AI was widely available; writing conditions not documented; not verified per author
persuade.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (README of scrosseye/persuade_corpus_2.0: "The data is provided under a CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 ... license")
persuade.license_checked: 2026-10-23, by Claude at the user's request: read the 2.0 README (license, citation, data links) and the 1.0 README and paper (PMC9767095)
persuade.citation: Crossley, S. A., Baffour, P., Tian, Y., Franklin, A., Benner, M., & Boser, U. (2024). A large-scale corpus for assessing written argumentation: PERSUADE 2.0. Assessing Writing, 61.
persuade.permitted_use: non-commercial research with attribution; adaptations share-alike. External detectors: only services whose terms say submissions are neither retained nor reused (otherwise local detectors only); not redistributed from this repository

ellipse.name: ELLIPSE corpus (English language learners)
ellipse.collected: during state-wide standardized annual testing in the US; publicly released through Kaggle's Feedback Prize ELL competition in 2022 (before November 2022); years not stated
ellipse.writers: US English language learners, grades 8-12 (ELL status assigned by the states)
ellipse.provenance_method: timed state test: 25-30 minutes, written on a computer, independent prompts with no source texts (ELLIPSE preprint, section 2.1); not verified per author
ellipse.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (README of scrosseye/ELLIPSE-Corpus: "The data is provided under a CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 ... license")
ellipse.license_checked: 2026-10-23, by Claude at the user's request: read the ELLIPSE-Corpus README and the preprint (zenodo.org/records/11217937)
ellipse.citation: Crossley, S. A., Tian, Y., Baffour, P., Franklin, A., Kim, Y., Morris, W., Benner, B., Picou, A., & Boser, U. (2023). Measuring second language proficiency using the ELLIPSE Corpus. International Journal of Learner Corpus Research, 9(2), 248-269.
ellipse.permitted_use: non-commercial research with attribution; adaptations share-alike. External detectors: only services whose terms say submissions are neither retained nor reused (otherwise local detectors only); not redistributed from this repository

micusp.name: Michigan Corpus of Upper-level Student Papers
micusp.provenance_method: submitted by students to the corpus project with consent; unsupervised writing
micusp.license: free for research and teaching, non-commercial; (c) Regents of the University of Michigan
micusp.permitted_use: to confirm whether submitting text to external detectors counts as permitted use
micusp.exclude_students: every student id used by data/human_corpus or data/sealed_test (editor sealed test)

wac.name: WAC Clearinghouse open-access books
wac.license: per book, mostly CC BY-NC-ND (to confirm per title)
